mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT g.parent_user_id FROM guardianship g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.parent_user_id WHERE g.status='LINKED' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.role='PARENT' ORDER BY g.parent_user_id
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('report:' || CAST(#{studentId} AS text) || ':' || CAST(#{from} AS text), 0))
SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND period_from=#{from} AND trigger='SCHEDULE'
SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM report_job WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND period_from=#{from} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
SELECT count(*) FROM report_job WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND period_from=#{from} AND trigger='REGENERATE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_execution(id,job_type,job_id,attempt_no,status,error_code,triggered_by,started_at,finished_at) VALUES(#{id},'REPORT',#{jobId},1,#{status},#{errorCode},#{actor},#{at}, CASE WHEN CAST(#{status} AS text)='RUNNING' THEN NULL ELSE #{at} END) ON CONFLICT(job_type,job_id,attempt_no) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status, error_code=EXCLUDED.error_code, finished_at=EXCLUDED.finished_at WHERE job_execution.status='RUNNING'
